page.notes: The "Varia" entry's first letters are slightly smudged; read as "Varia". The "Christi" in the Ejus spes entry has a gap in the print. Entries are transcribed line by line as printed, with hyphens kept at line ends. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines, so the entries and the drop-cap paragraph stop mid-word. The "Z." letter stands alone and is kept as a paragraph, not a heading. The drop-cap line "ZElus" is read as printed; the Z is a large initial. Some lines are read at low confidence and are not marked with [?] because the cut makes them hard to judge exactly. The index lines begin at the left edge of the scan, so their first words are fragments and are kept as printed. The page reference after "p. 6" is partly covered by a dark mark, so the final digit is doubtful. The superscript "8" after 578 and 98 is read as printed; it may be a line reference. "I N-" at the foot is uncertain and may be a catchword or a signature.
